Franz Beckenbauer has died. He passed away on 7 January 2024 at the age of 78, at his home in Salzburg, Austria. His family announced his death the following day.

Known as "Der Kaiser," he was one of the few people to win the World Cup as both a player (1974) and a manager (1990).
